topic: Circular debt: why it keeps growing even after every government promises to fix it
why_it_works: Pakistan added Rs364 billion to power-sector circular debt in FY2025-26 despite an IMF program explicitly targeting it down to Rs1.614 trillion — tracing the exact mechanism (DISCOs, K-Electric non-payment, subsidies) shows why this isn't political failure so much as a structurally self-renewing problem.

topic: What China actually gets from the 2026 CPEC revamp and Gwadar expansion
why_it_works: Xi and Shehbaz Sharif announced a 'new broad consensus' on CPEC and Gwadar in May 2026 — framed publicly as connectivity and development, but Pakistan owes China roughly $30B of its $124B external debt, and Gwadar sits inside China's wider String-of-Pearls port network, so the real question is what leverage this creates, not just what gets built.
sources: Al Jazeera - Pakistan and China reach new broad consensus (May 2026); Modern Diplomacy - China and Pakistan agree to revamp CPEC and expand Gwadar; debt figures need primary-source (SBP/Ministry of Finance) verification
